meta.description:
A single open interior plaza marked by four substantial pillar islands. Broad perimeter routes and central cross-passages provide long sightlines while the
    pillars create recognizable landmarks and prevent the space from feeling featureless.
structural_rules: Use a continuous outer wall enclosing the playable area.
Place four solid 5x5 pillar islands in the upper-left, upper-right, lower-left, and lower-right quadrants.
Keep the central area and the perimeter corridors open so every floor cell remains connected.
Leave at least two-cell-wide walking routes around each pillar island.
Use the pillar islands as the primary landmarks, with no sealed rooms or dead-end pockets.
